name: i-ching-reading
description: I Ching (Book of Changes) readings with structural-relational interpretation, not fortune-cookie glosses. Yarrow/coin casting, King Wen + nuclear + complementary hexagrams, and Chinese-first source reading from the complete Zhouyi, all 64 hexagrams (guaci, yaoci and daxiang) validated against ctext.org. Optional bitwise/Walsh-function and trajectory layers.
